name: Junior Summer Volunteer Program (JSVP)
what_you_do: Volunteer one 3 hour shift a week on the hospital campus. You also go to a one hour talk each week.
who_can_apply: High school students entering their junior or senior year who can commit to the full 8 weeks. Boston Public School students got the first application window. Preference goes to Boston residents.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: BPS students could apply Jan 21; all students Mar 6; it closed Mar 9 after 100 applications. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online when it opens in winter. The program talks only with you. It does not talk with family or teachers. Questions: juniorsummervolunteerprogram@bmc.org.
notes: In 2026 the form closed March 9 after 100 applications. That was three days after it opened to all students. The page says the program takes 70 students.
